oid_decode.definition: Decode only 40/64 ASCII hex; retain original spelling in typed archive; derive format from length

sha256.definition: SHA-256 of exact bytes; original asserted digest is separately archived

source_kind.definition: Explicit local-git/git-url/github discovery-kind enum mapping; unknown blocks

null.definition: Evidence absent; never invent historic value

caller.definition: Typed supplied field from future runtime or conversion manifest; validate target constraints

allocate_id.definition: Allocate local ID once in id_mappings, reuse committed mapping after restart; UUIDv4 for binding, preserve existing IDs elsewhere

lookup_binding.definition: Find exactly one GitHub binding for old repo/PR; ambiguous or conflicting binding blocks

lookup_body.definition: Map old version to text body by strong digest+length candidate and exact bytes; preserve each old version and observation ID

lookup_scope.definition: Allocate scope keyed by old collection and exact request/source/instance context; missing principal/version evidence sets legacy_unknown and forbids reuse

lookup_last_attempt.definition: Resolve jobs.attempt as latest stored attempt only; no synthetic attempts 1..N

replay_listing.definition: Resolve saved pages and code observation context to one stable listing; incompatible/missing page scope is partial, preserve old rows

lookup_occurrence.definition: Map saved page membership to occurrence; lack of origin goes to typed archive/unresolved, not a fabricated page

lookup_root.definition: Map old acquisition root through tracked seed mapping; role/repo/OID must match

lookup_cache.definition: Create readonly legacy locator, never import a live lease/reservation

lookup_cr.definition: Resolve acquisition repo and PR number against exactly one old PR and binding; ambiguity blocks

oid_format.definition: sha1 for 40 hex or 20 BLOB bytes, sha256 for 64 hex or 32 BLOB bytes; unknown remains NULL only where allowed

job_kind.definition: Explicit job kind vocabulary translation with raw request/state archived; unrecognized is legacy

legacy_state.definition: Validate known asserted enum; keep unknown raw in archive and expose unknown; never promote partial to complete

sqlite_exact_bytes.definition: Store typeof value plus INTEGER ASCII, REAL IEEE754 big endian, TEXT exact CAST bytes, BLOB exact bytes, NULL empty bytes
